name: coach-assessment
description: implement player assessment
---

<!-- Tip: Use /create-prompt in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->

- club admin or coach can schedule player assessments
- coach can start assessment like we did it for training sessions.
- once completed, the assessment results are recorded and made available for review by the coach and club admin and can generate detailed reports and insights for future training sessions.
- coach can assess player performance based on various metrics and observations during training sessions.
- AI can provide insights and recommendations for improving individual player skills and overall team performance.
- an automated system to track and evaluate player progress over time, helping coaches make informed decisions about training and development.
- integration with video analysis tools to provide a more comprehensive assessment of player performance.
- coach can provide feedback to players based on the assessment results via email or in-app notifications.
- integration with calendar tools to schedule follow-up assessments and training sessions based on player progress.
- integration with communication tools to facilitate seamless interaction between coaches, players, and club admins regarding assessment results and feedback.
- the upcoming assessments should appear in the coach dashboard for easy tracking and management and should have a link to view detailed assessment results like Upcoming sessions.
- a list that would show all players current level and if they had any assessment completed and when along with links to view detailed assessment results and any recommendations for improvement.
- integration with analytics tools to visualize player progress and assessment trends over time.
- once it takes it to the details view of the player's performance, it should display comprehensive metrics, historical assessment data, video analysis (if available), and any AI-generated recommendations for improvement along with graphs.
- the system should allow coaches to compare current assessment results with previous ones to track player development over time.
- integration with notification tools to alert coaches and players about upcoming assessments, completed assessments, and feedback availability.
- integration with reporting tools to generate comprehensive assessment reports for coaches, players, and club admins.
- make a table to display player assessment data, including player name, current level, assessment completion status, date of last assessment, and links to view detailed assessment results and recommendations for improvement. also use filters for the table, such as by player name, current level, and assessment completion status. additionally, provide sorting options for each column to allow coaches to quickly find and organize the data as needed.
- coach should be able to schedule player assessments directly from the dashboard, selecting the date, time, and players to be assessed in the list. 
- in each row there should be a button to schedule assessment, allowing coaches to quickly set up new assessments for individual players directly from the table.
- in each row there should be a button to export their assessment results, allowing coaches to quickly download individual player assessments directly from the table.
- in each row there should be a button to view detailed assessment results, allowing coaches to quickly access comprehensive performance data for individual players directly from the table and this should be another modal window. remove the current detail view from the main player progress page where we have a table. ensure that the modal window includes all relevant metrics, historical assessment data, video analysis (if available), and AI-generated recommendations for improvement along with graphs.
